parameters.name: Uid
parameters.description: The ID of the specified Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role within the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: page_number
parameters.description:
The current page number.

- Valid values: greater than or equal to 1.

- Default value: 1.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
The number of results returned per page.

- Valid values: 1 to 100.

- Default value: 50.
